posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Reportedly set to return to films with Chandni Bar 2 after maternity break. Remains in Bollywood's top 5 most popular actresses despite no release in over two years.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: His film Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali released June 12 to positive reviews. Continues his sold-out AURA World Tour 2026 with an LA show June 18 and Wembley Stadium on Sep 12.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha teaser dropped June 10 and crossed 75M views in 24 hours — the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film. Releases July 3 with Bobby Deol and Sharvari.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Ranked #3 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 — the only woman on their standalone cover. Currently shooting Rajamouli's Varanasi with Mahesh Babu.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King confirmed for Christmas 2026 release with a ₹350 crore budget. The star-studded action thriller features Suhana Khan, Deepika, Abhishek Bachchan, Anil Kapoor, and Rani Mukerji.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Gearing up for Daayra, a gritty thriller directed by Meghna Gulzar (Raazi fame) co-starring Prithviraj Sukumaran. Rumored for Salman Khan's Raj & DK superhero film but unconfirmed.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Her biographical drama Eetha locks August 28 release — she plays legendary Marathi Lavani performer Vithabai. Features Randeep Hooda and music by Ajay-Atul.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Announced second pregnancy with Ranveer Singh! Juggling filming for King with SRK and Atlee's Raka with Allu Arjun — using a body double for action sequences.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Celebrating second pregnancy announcement with Deepika. His Dhurandhar franchise crossed ₹3,100 crore worldwide across both chapters — one of the biggest Hindi franchises ever.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Made her 24th Cannes appearance in May, stunning in a Banarasi saree with sindoor that went viral. Closed the festival in dramatic swan-inspired couture with daughter Aaradhya by her side.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Reuniting with Allu Arjun in Atlee's massive sci-fi epic AA22xA6, playing a bold negative role. Married Vijay Deverakonda in February and is back on set shooting key sequences.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Her producer debut Maa Inti Bangaaram hits theatres June 19 — a family action drama set in the 1980s where she performs intense saree-clad stunts without a body double.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Filming Atlee's massive multi-starrer Raka with Deepika Padukone and the parallel-universe epic AA22xA6. Ranked #10 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi is a box office hit — crossed ₹185 crore net in India and $3M in North America within its first week. Joined the elite ₹150 crore share club in Telugu cinema.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Dragon with Prashanth Neel (KGF fame) is taking shape — Anil Kapoor joins as villain and Devara 2 poster expected for his upcoming birthday. Sporting a lean, chiseled new look.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Earned her career-highest fee of ₹8 crore for Peddi alongside Ram Charan. Now being called a 'golden-leg' actress in Telugu cinema after back-to-back hits with Devara.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Gearing up for Karan Johar's intense romantic drama Chand Mera Dil. Recently shared vacation moments on Instagram with sister in a fun European getaway.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Named among GQ's Most Influential Young Indians 2026. Congratulated Deepika and Ranveer on their second pregnancy announcement alongside other Bollywood stars.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Confirmed for a cameo as Kabir in Alpha alongside Alia Bhatt. Reportedly approached for a key role in Jailer 2 after SRK had to step away due to King schedule.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: His rom-com Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with dad David Dhawan released in theatres. Co-stars Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde in a classic Dhawan-style comedy of errors.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Announced 'The Unstoppable Tour' across North America this September — 12 arena dates including Prudential Center, Scotiabank Arena, and Oakland Arena.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Composed the acclaimed soundtrack for Main Vaapas Aaunga (now in theatres). Confirmed to reunite with Mani Ratnam for a new film starring Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Birthday celebrations building with Mersal set to re-release across 100 screens on June 19. His final film Jananayagan eyes a post-birthday release window as fans await the superstar-turned-politician.
